title: Grateful Dead Live at Hofheinz Pavilion on 1972-11-19
source: Recording Info: SBD -> Master Reel -> Reel (7.5ips 2 track/Dolby B); Transfer Info: Reel (Dolby B Decoded) -> WAV (24bit/96k); Mastering Info: WAV (24bit/96k) -> Adobe Audition v3.0 -> Samplitude Professional v11.2.1 -> FLAC/24; Reels supplied and Transferred By David Gans; Mastered By Charlie Miller; This is a cleaned up version of source ID 122784

ai_review.summary: High‑energy 11/19/72 Houston show captured on a soundboard with good clarity despite minor fade issues, featuring smoking Dark Star, China Cat Sunflower and a phenomenal Stella Blue.
ai_review.review: The performance is consistently praised for its fire – Dark Star, China Cat, Playin’ in the Band, Jack Straw and especially Stella Blue are highlighted as standout moments. The soundboard source delivers a clear mix with Jerry’s guitar and Phil’s bass sitting prominently up front, though a few listeners note occasional fade‑outs and “Bertha” drum quirks.

ai_rating.rationale: All five reviews are 5‑star, emphasizing superb musical moments and a generally clean soundboard recording with only minor technical blemishes.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Overall clear mix with Jerry’s guitar and Phil’s bass prominent; some listeners note occasional fade‑outs and a “Bertha” drum issue, but the sound remains listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds strong momentum and the second set launches into extended jams, delivering a balanced flow from tight song work to expansive improvisation.

band_member_comments.Jerry: High in the mix; guitar work praised on Bird Song and backing vocals noted on B.I.O.D.T.L.; overall strong presence.
band_member_comments.Phil: Bass isolated and hot, higher in the mix throughout; phenomenal on Stella Blue and Box of Rain; “Phil bombs” vibe mentioned.
band_member_comments.Drums: Bertha (Bill Kreutzmann) present but with some sound‑issue comments; overall rhythm section busy.
